verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce ships developer tooling (Link CLI, Stripe CLI, hosted MCP server), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out mechanism. The consent-gated financial data sharing and OCA termination items concern payment and data access between parties, not product telemetry, so they do not count toward this story.
